name: US panel with sodium transcribed in grams
source_note: Negative control for the unit handling, and the only fixture that declares a nutrient in a unit other than the one its rounding rule is written in. Export packaging routinely prints sodium in grams alongside a US-shaped per-serving panel, and a hand transcription of one lands here. The tool has to convert 0.16 g into 160 mg BEFORE inverting, because inverting first would apply the gram-sized rule to a milligram figure and put the answer out by a factor of a thousand. Every other row is internally consistent, so this label must raise no flag.
